svg.title: Kapitsa: a blazing fast Apple Silicon optimized inference engine built for Qwen, Nemotron and Flint
svg.desc: Writing speed in tokens per second for Qwen3.6 35B-A3B at 4-bit on a MacBook Pro (2024), M4 Pro, 48 GB: llama.cpp with MTP 69, MTPLX with MTP 80, LM Studio with no spec 86, Ollama with MTP 89, oMLX with DFlash2 127, Splash with DFlash2 135, Kapitsa with KFlash 161.
